dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular closed-loop and semi-closed 'C' shaped structures are visible in the upper-left quadrant. The boundaries consist of high-intensity pixels forming a narrow band with a sharp transition into the low-intensity interior and exterior regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of small, solid white speckles located primarily along the high-contrast boundaries of the macro-annuli and scattered within larger dark regions in the upper-left quadrant.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent ring-like structures in the upper-left define an irregular quadrilateral with its longest axis oriented approximately parallel to the dorsal line.
